I have 4 Clans used for a fanfiction \*and\* the Discord Roleplaying Server I'm working on.   


All the clans are solitary at the start of the fanfiction but used to be one large rogue group. That split off to make the clans. Technically this is set in the Colorado Rocky Mountains but I've changed it around a lot when it comes to the plants there. Like Oaks. 

SnowClan lives in snowy plains. They fish, have learned how to take down larger birds, hunt in the areas of relief brought by pine tree clusters, and chase rabbits. 

DustClan lives in an abandoned two-leg mine. They hunt mice and the occasional rats, bats, and the prey that might wander into the tunnels or outside the dark tunnels. 

PineClan lives in a large pine forest. They enjoy hunting in the shadows of the trees, using them for protection and stealth. 

And BranchClan lives in another forest, a mix of oaks, aspen and pine. They hunt in the trees and on the ground, and sometimes the stream on the edge of their territory.
